flows.title: Choose which meetings the Notetaker joins
steps: Open Account Settings and go to the Meetings page, where every Notetaker setting lives.

Under Auto-join settings, choose when Notetaker automatically joins and records a calendar event with a valid Zoom, Google Meet or Microsoft Teams link: Meetings with a video link, Meetings where I am the host, External meetings outside your domain, Internal meetings within your domain, or Meetings I manually select. Which of these you see depends on your account.
The external and internal choices apply only to users in a Workspace with a business domain.
With Meetings I manually select, Notetaker joins only the events you have toggled auto-join on for, which you manage from the calendar on the Otter homepage.

flows.title: Choose who recorded meetings are shared with
steps: Open Account Settings and go to the Meetings page. The homepage's Meetings tab also gives quick access to share settings.

Under Auto-share settings, choose the default for conversations recorded from a calendar event: All event guests, Same domain guests (not offered for generic domains such as Gmail), Workspace members, or Don't Share to keep meeting notes private.
Set the Default permission level: a Viewer can only view and play back the conversation, while a Collaborator can also edit and export it.
Turn Allow Collaborators to share on only if Collaborators should be able to share the conversation with other people.
To treat one calendar event differently, manage it from the Meeting or Calendar tab on the Otter homepage.
